name: Rewriting The Legend
source:
Struggling with heartbreak can be a long and lonely endeavor. Just when you finally get yourself back on your own two feet, a chance visit to an antique shop catapults you into the midst of a chivalric romance. Faced with magic, bloodshed, and a hazel-eyed savior who’s more than he lets on, you find yourself torn between two worlds as your heart grows increasingly enraptured by this gallant figure.

Perhaps enraptured enough to want to stay in his arms.

Will you take this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to rewrite the pages of legend?

[From [url=https://mei18.itch.io/rewriting-the-legend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与心碎作斗争可能是一项漫长而孤独的努力。就在你终于重新站起来时，一次偶然的机会参观了一家古董店，让你陷入了骑士般的浪漫之中。面对魔法、流血和一个淡褐色眼睛的救世主，你会发现自己在两个世界之间左右为难，因为你的心越来越被这个英勇的人物迷住。

也许是太高兴了，想要留在他的怀里。

你会抓住这个千载难逢的机会改写传奇吗？

[来自[url=https://mei18.itch.io/rewriting-the-legend]Itch.io[/url]]
